The '''Rod of the Sea''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Fishing Rod]]. It is unlocked at {{Skl|fishing|24}}.

=== Crafting ===

== Trivia ==
*The '''Rod of the Sea''' is the only [[Fishing Rod]] to not require a [[Collection]] to craft.
* Despite being a further upgrade to the {{Item|Challenging Rod}}, it does not grant any {{Stat|Treasure Chance}}.
